narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On June 25, 2024, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a farm in Hart, Michigan, during a follow-up on an earlier encounter with his employer. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no documents. He showed a Mexican birth certificate and a voter identification card.
ENTRY:
When first asked, the subject said that he came to the United States in 2017. A moment later he corrected himself, explaining that 2017 was when his brother arrived, and stated that he himself crossed the river illegally near McAllen, Texas, in March 2015.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
